shortDescription: VM module which supports VM CRUD states

options.name: boot_config
options.description: Indicates whether the VM should use Secure boot, UEFI boot or Legacy boot.

options.name: categories
options.description: categories to be attached to the VM.

options.name: cluster
options.description: Name or UUID of the cluster on which the VM will be placed

options.name: cores_per_vcpu
options.description: This is the number of vcpus per socket

options.name: desc
options.description: A description for VM.

options.name: disks
options.description: List of disks attached to the VM

options.name: force_power_off
options.description: when set the vm will restart if it's necessary

options.name: guest_customization
options.description: cloud_init or sysprep guest customization

options.name: memory_gb
options.description: Memory size in GB

options.name: name
options.description: VM Name

options.name: networks
options.description: list of subnets to which the VM needs to connect to

options.name: nutanix_api_key
options.description: Prism central API key. Created using Service Account API Key in Prism Central. C(nutanix_api_key). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_API_KEY), environment variable is used. This field is only supported for Prism Central.

options.name: nutanix_debug
options.description: Enable detailed debug logging for all API calls made by this module. When enabled, logs will include HTTP method, URL, headers, request body, response body, status code, and elapsed time. Authorization headers and sensitive information are automatically redacted. This parameter can also be set via the NUTANIX_DEBUG environment variable and is preferred over the NUTANIX_DEBUG environment variable.

options.name: nutanix_host
options.description: Prism central hostname or IP address C(nutanix_host). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_HOST), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_log_file
options.description: The file to write the logs to. This parameter can also be set via the NUTANIX_LOG_FILE environment variable and is preferred over the NUTANIX_LOG_FILE environment variable.

options.name: nutanix_password
options.description: Prism central password C(nutanix_password). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_PASSWORD), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_port
options.description: Prism central port C(nutanix_port). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_PORT), environment variable is used.

options.name: nutanix_username
options.description: Prism central username C(nutanix_username). If not set then the value of the C(NUTANIX_USERNAME), environment variable is used.

options.name: owner
options.description: Name or UUID of the owner

options.name: project
options.description: Name or UUID of the project

options.name: remove_categories
options.description: When set will remove all categories attached to the vm. Mutually exclusive ith C(categories)

options.name: state
options.description: Specify state If C(state) is set to C(present) then the operation will be  create the item If C(state) is set to C(absent) and if the item exists, then item is removed. If C(state) is set to C(power_on) then the operation will be  power on the VM If C(state) is set to C(power_off) then the operation will be  power off the VM If C(state) is set to C(soft_shutdown) then the operation will be  soft shutdown  the VM If C(state) is set to C(hard_poweroff) then the operation will be  hard poweroff  th

options.name: timezone
options.description: VM's hardware clock timezone in IANA TZDB format (America/Los_Angeles).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Set value to C(False) to skip validation for self signed certificates This is not recommended for production setup C(validate_certs). If not set then the value of the C(VALIDATE_CERTS), environment variable is used.

options.name: vcpus
options.description: Number of sockets

options.name: vm_uuid
options.description: VM UUID will be used to update if C(state) is C(present) and to delete if C(state) is C(absent)

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the  CRUD operation to complete.
